agent_answers: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In extractFile, the tainted entry name from ZipEntry.getName() is resolved into File f via FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName), and the only restriction is the check `if ( !f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith( dir.getAbsolutePath() ) ) throw new IOException(...)`. This prefix-based containment check is inadequate because a path such as /tmp/out_evil starts with /tmp/out but is outside the destination directory, so attacker-controlled entry names can still reach `new FileOutputStream(f)`."}]}
